verdicts.title: Deposits/harvest use provideToSP(...,false), stashing collateral gains that tend never sees

a.reden: The candidate describes a distinct issue with provideToSP false flag and stashed collateral gains, which does not correspond to any of the listed known findings.

b.reden: The candidate describes stashed collateral gains being hidden from the tend trigger, which is a different root cause from the known findings.

verdicts.title: Pending BOLD yield from the Stability Pool is never counted or claimed by harvest

a.reden: The candidate describes a missing yield claim issue, which does not correspond to any of the listed findings.

b.reden: The candidate describes unclaimed Stability Pool yield omitted from harvest/accounting, which is unrelated to the known inflation, loss-timing, or dustThreshold findings.

verdicts.title: Collateral gains excluded from totalAssets let late depositors capture recovery after a temporary loss

a.reden: Both describe the same timing exploit where deposits between a loss report and collateral auction/recovery let attackers capture undervalued shares

b.reden: Same root cause and impact: depositing between a reported loss and the later collateral auction recovery lets the depositor capture the recovered value at the expense of existing holders.

verdicts.title: Permissionless StakerFactory.newStrategy lets anyone overwrite deployments[asset] registry

a.reden: The candidate describes an access control issue in StakerFactory.newStrategy, which is unrelated to the root causes of the known findings.

b.reden: The candidate describes a permissionless StakerFactory registry overwrite, which is unrelated to the known findings about share inflation, loss-timing deposits, or dustThreshold.

verdicts.title: Accountant takes full fee on a gain even if a loss on another strategy is not yet reported

a.reden: The candidate describes a fee overcharging issue in Accountant.sol, which does not correspond to any of the listed findings.

b.reden: The candidate describes fee overcharging in Accountant.report() due to unrealized losses, which is unrelated to the known findings about strategy share inflation, deposit timing after loss reports, or

verdicts.title: Accountant distributes held fee shares to the Staker even while yBOLD is below 1:1 (loss never covered)

a.reden: The candidate describes a fee distribution logic flaw in Accountant.sol, which does not correspond to any of the listed findings about share inflation, deposit timing, or dustThreshold limits.

b.reden: The candidate concerns Accountant fee-share distribution during losses, which is unrelated to the known findings about first-depositor inflation, loss-timing deposits, or dustThreshold.

verdicts.title: Strategies and Staker deployed by the factories keep the default 10% performance fee, leaking yield away from the Accountant

a.reden: The candidate describes a performance fee default issue, which does not correspond to any of the listed findings.

b.reden: The candidate describes a missing performance fee initialization, which is a different root cause and impact than any of the known findings (share inflation, timing attack, dust threshold lock).

verdicts.title: Staker pins the vault's accountant at construction; a later accountant change or a feeRecipient mismatch breaks every report

a.reden: The candidate describes a distinct issue with Staker's accountant immutability, which does not correspond to any of the listed findings.

b.reden: The candidate describes an immutable accountant/feeRecipient mismatch breaking reports, which is unrelated to the known findings about share inflation, loss-timing deposits, or dustThreshold.

verdicts.title: Strategy withdraw/claim reverts when SP deposit is zero (_requireUserHasDeposit)

a.reden: The candidate describes a revert due to zero deposit, which does not correspond to any of the listed findings.

b.reden: The candidate describes a revert when SP deposit is zero, which is not covered by any of the known findings.

verdicts.title: Auction starting price truncated to whole BOLD units, which erodes the buffer on small lots

a.reden: The candidate describes a rounding issue in _tend() affecting auction start price, which is unrelated to the listed findings.

b.reden: The candidate describes a price truncation bug in the auction starting price calculation, which is not the same root cause or code as any of the known findings (H-1, H-2, M-1).
